content: sweet_xml (xmerl-based, XPath sigils ~x, simple API, higher memory ~1GB on large docs) vs saxy (SAX event-based, 1.4-10x less memory than xmerl-based parsers, no XPath, requires handler module). For small per-game XML responses (a few KB each, hundreds of requests) sweet_xml's ergonomics outweigh its memory overhead since documents are tiny, not the multi-MB documents where saxy's efficiency matters.
